t: Adolfo Sport For Men Adolfo Fragrances cologne - a fragrance for men
s: I also have Thallium Sport (TS) which is another 'cheapie hidden gem' & a 'cheap' CAHS Eau Extreme clone, both AS & TS are some what synthetic (especially compared to Chanel) and you can tell at first spray, but TS is sweet-creamy like CAHS Eau Extreme and AS is fresh-clean like Allure Home Sport but AS does has a citrus-windex cleaner like tinge; only knock is how light it is, the fragrance isn't even moderately bold or pronouncing very light in-close/intimate scent pretty much from start to finish, but smells so good. Even though Thallium Sport is good too for a 'cheapie', I wish I found Adolfo Sport 1st, the scent, bottle, cap, & atomizer are better than TS; very good value, if it were a little louder it'd be a great value & a love instead of like.
